{"consolidated_memory":"**Leaked field in platform/logging/redact.go redactor — two separate incidents**

Component: platform/logging/redact.go (Go stack)
Covering test: platform/logging/redact_test.go

Problem (both occasions): A field that should have been masked appears in log output when the nested payload fixture is logged.

---

**OCCASION 1: [2026-02-20]**
- Trigger: Manifested only for users sitting in negative UTC offset timezones
- Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #2039 on branch fix/leaked-field-1
- Outcome: Flaky test went from 59 failures per hundred runs to zero

**OCCASION 2: [2026-04-14]**
- Trigger: Manifested only for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #5101 on branch fix/leaked-field-2
- Outcome: Alert stayed quiet for 71 consecutive days"}
